description: The protocol an accepted upgrade speaks (ADR 0036 S12): one text frame per item, each a process-stream item, oldest first. The record's process.* events and its log lines arrive in one order, a gap item states log bytes the bound discarded before the reader reached them, and exactly one ended item closes the stream. A stream the daemon can no longer serve closes with WebSocket status 1011 and no ended item; the reader reconnects with its last cursor. A slow reader never blocks the program: the stream reads the log file, not the program's pipes. Concurrent streams are bounded per record (max_readers) and, over every record live or ended, per subject (max_subject_streams) and per deployment (max_deployment_streams); past any of them the next is process.events-readers-exceeded before the upgrade.
title: process-events operation result
